summary.text: Thomas Murphy is an independent write-in candidate for U.S. Senate in Kentucky, campaigning as 'BRAVE 2026 - Murphy for Kentucky.' No biographical profile of his education, career or prior offices was found.

paragraphs.text: His campaign website, titled 'BRAVE 2026 - Murphy for Kentucky,' says 'Parties are the Problem' and directs voters to write in his name for U.S. Senate; it gives no biographical details.

sources.title: United States Senate election in Kentucky, 2026
